hello.name: hello-ascii
hello.note: PeerId 'alice'. Body = magic 6b75696c, version 01, idLen 00000005, id.

hello.name: hello-utf8-multibyte
hello.note: PeerId 'Zoë🧵' (Z, o, U+00EB, U+1F9F5): 4 code points, 8 UTF-8 bytes. idLen counts bytes.

frames.name: payload-binary
frames.note: An opaque 5-byte payload. The frame is its length, then the bytes, and nothing else.

frames.name: payload-empty
frames.note: A zero-length payload is a legal frame: a bare 00000000 prefix.

helloRefusals.name: legacy-bare-utf8
helloRefusals.note: The pre-v1 hello: the PeerId as bare UTF-8, with no magic.

helloRefusals.name: legacy-bare-utf8-starting-kuil
helloRefusals.note: A pre-v1 hello whose id happens to start with 'kuil'. The magic matches; the next byte (0x74, 't') is not a supported version.

helloRefusals.name: idlen-overruns-body
helloRefusals.note: idLen says 6; only 5 id bytes follow.

helloRefusals.name: idlen-leaves-trailing-bytes
helloRefusals.note: idLen says 4; 5 id bytes follow. v1 forbids trailing bytes.

helloRefusals.name: idlen-huge
helloRefusals.note: idLen ffffffff, refused from the header alone, before allocating.

helloRefusals.name: header-truncated
helloRefusals.note: Magic and version present; idLen cut short.

helloRefusals.name: magic-only
helloRefusals.note: The magic and nothing after it: there is no version byte to read.

helloRefusals.name: magic-prefix-only
helloRefusals.note: Two bytes that agree with the magic as far as they go. Magic is compared over the bytes present, so this is truncated, not foreign.

helloRefusals.name: short-foreign-body
helloRefusals.note: Two bytes that disagree with the magic. Magic is checked first, so this is foreign, not truncated.

helloRefusals.name: invalid-utf8
helloRefusals.note: c3 opens a 2-byte sequence; 28 is not a continuation byte.

helloRefusals.name: utf8-encoded-surrogate
helloRefusals.note: ed a0 80 encodes the lone surrogate U+D800, which strict UTF-8 forbids.

streams.name: close-at-frame-boundary
streams.note: Two frames, then EOF exactly after the second: a clean close.

streams.name: eof-mid-body
streams.note: The prefix promises 10 bytes; 2 arrive, then EOF.

streams.name: eof-mid-body-after-a-good-frame
streams.note: The first frame is delivered; the second is cut short.

streams.name: eof-mid-prefix
streams.note: EOF two bytes into a length prefix. No partial frame is delivered; v1 lets the receiver report it as an error or as a close.

streams.name: prefix-high-bit-set
streams.note: 80000000 is negative as a signed 32-bit int and over the max as an unsigned one. Refused either way.

handshake.name: two-sided-transcript
handshake.note: a dials b. Each writes its Hello first, without waiting, then its payloads, then closes at a frame boundary. 'bytes' is everything that side writes, in order.

handshakeRefusals.name: self-connection
handshakeRefusals.note: The peer's Hello names our own id.

handshakeRefusals.name: first-frame-not-a-hello
handshakeRefusals.note: The peer's first frame is a payload, not a Hello.
